verdict.rationale: Pylon's Assist Agent is documented as an interactive AI teammate that investigates, drafts replies, and takes action while humans direct it (pylon-docs-41, pylon-docs-66), and Support Agent deployment lets ops control which issues the AI touches and review outcomes via the issue log (pylon-docs-18, pylon-docs-19). However, there's no explicit documentation of a formal 'supervised/approval mode' toggle or a required human sign-off step before a drafted reply reaches a customer — the Support Agent can also autonomously 'deflect' customer questions, suggesting some flows bypass human review. Missing for 10: explicit approval-gate/workflow setting, documentation distinguishing autonomous vs. human-approval modes, and independent/hands-on confirmation that replies are held for review.
